newsitem.title: FINLAND: ARSENAL TO PUBLISH NON-LISTED SHARES ON INTERNET.
newsitem.headline: ARSENAL TO PUBLISH NON-LISTED SHARES ON INTERNET.

text.p: Finnish state asset management company Arsenal said on Thursday it planned to publish on the internet information on its holdings in about 160 non-listed companies that it plans to sell.
"The shares are in local, unlisted companies and associations," it said.
The site would be found through www.arsenal.fi, it said.
Arsenal said bids could not be submitted on the net but contact numbers of sales executives would be available.
Arsenal was set up in 1993 to manage bad loans and assets the state took over during the banking crisis early this decade.
